claim.value: A test stopped before the one-hour threshold has an unknown threshold outcome and must not be counted as fast.
claim.scope: Early termination of a test, distinct from observing a completed fast export.

provenance.rationale: The span supplies the early-termination condition, unknown outcome and counting consequence.

signal_basis.value: Observation stops before one hour without observing export completion, leaving whether the export would exceed one hour unobserved.
signal_basis.scope: A prematurely stopped test with no completed export outcome.

provenance.rationale: The span explicitly distinguishes crossing the threshold from stopping a test before its threshold outcome is known.
The claim follows from the incomplete observation; no unresolved empirical relation is required.

rationale: Stopping observation before the threshold without observing completion cannot establish completion within one hour. Counting that outcome as fast would assign an unobserved result.
uncertainty: The eventual duration is unknown; this uncertainty supports the claim within its explicit scope.
